deadline.value: Fall 2027 international application closing date is July 15, 2027 (Spring 2027 international closing date: December 15; Summer not open to international students). Priority consideration for university assistantships or fellowships is January 15, 2027.
deadline.quote: For fall applicants, the date for priority consideration for university assistantships or fellowships is January 15. | Application closing dates: | International application: July 15 | Note: International students may only apply for fall or spring.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for Biology (ETS discontinued Biochemistry, Cell & Molecular Biology in 2016 and Biology in 2021; offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Program and catalog pages do not state whether an advisor must be contacted or secured prior to admission (dissertation committee is formed after completing formal coursework).

funding.value: A limited number of graduate assistantships are available on a competitive basis.
funding.quote: A limited number of assistantships are available on a competitive basis. This award is subject to the work needs of the position and department, your satisfactory performance of duties, your academic record, and availability of funds, and may be subject to change.

entry_route.value: University Graduate Admissions FAQs confirm that UMass Dartmouth doctoral programs consider applicants with either a bachelor's degree only or a bachelor's and master's degree (55 total credits required for Integrative Biology Ph.D.).
entry_route.quote: Can I apply for a PhD program with only a bachelor's degree? | Yes. Our doctoral programs can consider applicants with a bachelor's only or a bachelor's and a master's.

notes: Note: Language Proficiency page specifies that Biology/Marine Biology does not accept Duolingo (use TOEFL, IELTS, or PTE Academic). Graduate Admissions FAQs mention an outdated Subject GRE recommendation for Biology/Marine Biology and Research Psychology assistantships, though ETS discontinued the Biology Subject Test in 2021.
name: Integrative Biology Ph.D.
